title: Propose knowledge for a feature that has no work item
action: Make bee knowledge promote resolve a feature slug through the shared resolver kl-1 added, so a feature with no bee.work-item concept can still propose the knowledge it earned (per D1). Replace promote.rs's own work-item find at promote.rs:367-374 with resolve_anchor, keeping its unknown_work message byte for byte, including the (D38) tag, for the case where neither a concept nor any history file exists. Under the history arm: the proposed delivery save path is the canonical docs/knowledge/work/<slug>/delivery.md — a PROPOSAL only, nothing is written, so D5 still holds — and the work_item field in the payload at promote.rs:676 carries the anchor's repo-relative paths instead of a concept path. Add the same anchor object naming kind and paths to the proposal payload at promote.rs:674-685, plus one plain-text line naming the anchor. Empty bee.areas keeps its existing render at promote.rs:714-720 — do not change that text. writes stays [] in every case; promote proposes and never writes (D38, docs/knowledge/areas/okf-profile/context-and-promote.md:147). Second half of this cell, per D8: drivers/prepare.rs:266-279 already passes a cell's feature slug as work and maps ManifestOut::Thrown(_) to None, so today every dispatched worker prompt for a feature with no work item silently ships with no learned-context manifest. It inherits kl-1's fix through kctx, so this cell adds no code there — it adds the TEST that proves it: a dispatched cell whose feature has only docs/history/<slug>/CONTEXT.md now carries a manifest instead of None. Judge existing coverage first: promotion is pinned at verbs/knowledge/tests.rs:402 and its unknown_work at :505. Author only the gap.
